Similar is ﴿هَذَا بَصَائر لِلنَّاسِ﴾; had it been "hādhihi baṣāʾir li-l-nās" it would be correct. Similar is ﴿هَذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّى﴾; had it been "hādhihi raḥma", it would be permissible.

farraa:53-53.t: His saying: ﴿وَلَوْلاَ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى﴾: he says: were it not that Allah has made the punishment of this community deferred to the Day of Resurrection — that is the term — the punishment would have come to them. Then He said ﴿وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بَغْتَةً﴾, meaning the Resurrection; He made it masculine because He means the punishment of the Resurrection. And if you wish, you may make it masculine following the masculine of "term". Had it been ﴿وَلَتَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ﴾ it would be correct, meaning the Resurrection and the Hour.

farraa:55-55.t: His saying: ﴿وَيِقُولُ ذُوقُواْ﴾: in the reading of ʿAbd Allāh it is (ويقال ذوقوا), and some read (وَنَقُولُ) with the nūn; all are correct.

farraa:56-56.t: His saying: ﴿يٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوۤاْ إِنَّ أَرْضِي وَاسِعَةٌ﴾: this is for the Muslims among the people of Mecca who were staying with the idolaters. He says ﴿إِنَّ أَرْضِي وَاسِعَةٌ﴾, meaning Medina, i.e. so do not live as neighbours of the people of disbelief.

farraa:58-58.t: His saying: ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ﴾: the generality read it ﴿لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ﴾. Qays related to me from Abū Isḥāq that Ibn Masʿūd read it (لنُثْوِيَنَّهُمْ), and Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb read it likewise. Both are good: bawwaʾtuhu manzilan and athwaytuhu manzilan (I lodged him in a dwelling).

farraa:60-60.t: His saying [Translator's note: the source has «وقولوا», a slip for «وقوله»]: ﴿وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍ﴾: it was revealed about the believers among the people of Mecca. When they were ordered to move away from it and go out to Medina, they said: O Messenger of Allah, we have no dwellings or wealth in Medina, so where will our livelihood come from? So Allah sent down ﴿وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍ لاَّ تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا﴾: it does not store its provision or gather it — i.e. so are all the creeping creatures of the earth, except the ant, for it stores its provision for its year.

farraa:64-64.t: His saying: ﴿وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلآخِرَةَ لَهِيَ ٱلْحَيَوَانُ﴾: a life in which there is no death.

farraa:65-65.t: His saying: ﴿إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ﴾: he says: they make their supplication and their affirmation of oneness sincerely for Allah at sea, and when He has saved them they turn to the worship of idols.

farraa:66-66.t: His saying: ﴿وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُواْ﴾: ʿĀṣim and al-Aʿmash read it as a command and a rebuke, with the lām vowelless (wa-l-yatamattaʿū); and the people of the Hijaz read it ﴿وَلِيَتَمَتَّعوا﴾ with kasra, in the sense of kay (in order that).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿والذين كفروا بآيات الله ولقائه أولئك يئسوا من رحمتي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿بآيات الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كفروا﴾, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); لقائه is conjoined to آيات; أولئك is a mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يئسوا من رحمتي﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أولئك; and the clause ﴿أولئك يئسوا﴾ is the khabar of الذين.
﴿وأولئك لهم عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أولئك is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); عذاب is the postponed mubtadaʾ; أليم is a naʿt (adjective) of عذاب; and the clause ﴿لهم عذاب أليم﴾ is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا اقتلوه أو حرقوه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ما is negating; كان is a defective past verb; جواب is its fronted khabar (predicate); إلا is a particle of restriction; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن قالوا﴾ is the postponed noun of كان; ﴿اقتلوه﴾ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; and ﴿حرقوه﴾ is conjoined to اقتلوه.
﴿فأنجاه الله من النار إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يؤمنون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted clause), i.e. "so they threw him into the fire, and Allah saved him." ﴿أنجاه الله﴾ is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil (agent); ﴿من النار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنجاه﴾; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is its postponed noun; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آيات; and the clause ﴿يؤمنون﴾ is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وقال إنما اتخذتم من دون الله أوثانا مودة بينكم في الحياة الدنيا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قال is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); إنما is the restraining ما with the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); اتخذتم is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿من دون الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted second object of ﴿اتخذتم﴾, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); أوثانًا is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿اتخذتم﴾; ﴿مودة﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or it is accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being "I mean"; ﴿بينِكم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿في الحياة الدنيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اتخذتم﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and الدنيا is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; ﴿الدنيا﴾ is in fact a naʿt (adjective) of الحياة.]
﴿ثم يوم القيامة يكفر بعضكم ببعض ويلعن بعضكم بعضا﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī); يوم القيامة: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يكفر﴾, and القيامة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); يكفر: an imperfect verb; بعضكم: the fāʿil (agent); ببعض: a preposition and its genitive noun likewise attached to ﴿يكفر﴾; ﴿ويلعن بعضكم بعضًا﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil, and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ومأواكم النار وما لكم من ناصرين﴾: مأواكم: mubtadaʾ (subject); and النار: khabar (predicate). ﴿وما لكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a fronted khabar; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) particle; and ناصرين is the postponed mubtadaʾ, genitive in form.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿فآمن له لوط وقال إني مهاجر إلى ربي إنه هو العزيز الحكيم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; آمن is a past verb; لوط is its fāʿil (agent); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمن﴾; قال is conjoined to ﴿فآمن﴾, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring to Ibrāhīm; وقال: the wāw is a conjunction, قال is a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun [Translator's note: the source analyses وقال twice, as written]; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and مهاجر is its khabar (predicate); ﴿إلى ربي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مهاجر﴾; إن is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ (subject); العزيز is the khabar of إن, or the khabar of ﴿هو﴾, the clause then being the khabar of إن; and الحكيم is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ووهبنا له إسحاق ويعقوب وجعلنا في ذريته النبوة والكتاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; وهبنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وهبنا﴾; إسحاق is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and يعقوب is conjoined to it; ﴿جعلنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿في ذريته﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second object; النبوة is the first object; and الكتاب is conjoined to النبوة.
﴿وآتيناه أجره في الدنيا وإنه في الآخرة لمن الصالحين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آتيناه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أجره is a second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿في الدنيا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun; في الآخرة: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and من الصالحين: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿ولوطا إذ قال لقومه إنكم لتأتون الفاحشة ما سبقكم بها من أحد من العالمين﴾: [لوطًا is] conjoined to إبراهيم, or accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember"; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of ﴿لوطا﴾; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿لقومه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the clause ﴿إنكم لتأتون﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿كم﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause تأتون is its khabar (predicate), the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); الفاحشة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ما سبقكم﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), a clause with no grammatical position — and it was said: a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, i.e. "do you commit the indecency as its innovators, not preceded in it?"; ما is negating; سبقكم is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿سبقكم﴾; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) particle; أحد is genitive in form, nominative in position as the fāʿil of سبقكم; and ﴿من العالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحد.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿أئنكم لتأتون الرجال وتقطعون السبيل وتأتون في ناديكم المنكر﴾: the hamza is interrogative; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿كم﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause تأتون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; الرجال is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); تقطعون السبيل is conjoined to تأتون الرجال; تأتون is likewise conjoined; في ناديكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تأتون﴾; and المنكر is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا ائتنا بعذاب الله إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ما is negating; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective past verb; ﴿جواب﴾: the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; ﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction; أن with what falls within its scope is the postponed noun of كان; the clause ﴿ائتنا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿ائتنا﴾ is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بعذاب الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ائتنا﴾; إن is conditional; كنت is a defective past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ being its noun; من الصادقين: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of إن [Translator's note: so in the source; it is the khabar of كان (كنت)]; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of إن is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then bring us Allah's punishment."

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿قال رب انصرني على القوم المفسدين﴾: رب is a vocative (munādā) annexed to the omitted first-person yāʾ, and the vocative particle is omitted; انصرني: a verb of supplication, the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); على القوم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿انصرني﴾; and المفسدين is a naʿt (adjective) of القوم.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿ولما جاءت رسلنا إبراهيم بالبشرى قالوا إنا مهلكو أهل هذه القرية﴾: the wāw conjoins to something omitted; لما is temporal ("when"), or linking (rābiṭa); ﴿جاءت رسلنا إبراهيم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالبشرى: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءت﴾; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the clause ﴿إنا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and ﴿مهلكو﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿أهل هذه﴾ are [each] muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [Translator's note: the source says «مضافين», "two annexed words"]; and القرية is a badal (substitute) of هذه.
﴿إن أهلها كانوا ظالمين﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is a statement of cause (taʿlīl); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); أهلها is the noun of إن; the clause كانوا is its khabar (predicate); and ظالمين is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿قال إن فيها لوطا قالوا نحن أعلم بمن فيها﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿لوطًا﴾ is its postponed noun; ﴿قالوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); نحن is a mubtadaʾ (subject); أعلم is the khabar; بمن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿لننجينه وأهله إلا امرأته كانت من الغابرين﴾: the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; ننجينه is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we", and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أهله is conjoined to the hāʾ, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); إلا is a particle of exception; امرأته is the excepted; the clause كانت is a ḥāl (circumstantial); كانت is a defective past verb whose noun is latent; and من الغابرين: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿كانت﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿ولما أن جاءت رسلنا لوطا سيء بهم وضاق بهم ذرعا﴾: the wāw: resumptive; لما: temporal ("when"); أن: connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); جاءت: a past verb; رسلنا: fāʿil (agent); لوطًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿سيء بهم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the response of ﴿لَمّا﴾; ﴿سيء﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he", referring to Lūṭ; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سيء﴾; ﴿ضاق بهم﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿سيء بهم﴾; and ذرعًا: a tamyīz (specification) converted from the fāʿil, i.e. "his capacity (dharʿuhu) was straitened by them."
﴿وقالوا لا تخف ولا تحزن إنا منجوك وأهلك إلا امرأتك كانت من الغابرين﴾: the wāw: conjunction; قالوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿وقالوا لا تخف﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿سيء بهم﴾; إنا: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and ﴿منجوك﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the kāf in ﴿منجوك﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation; أهلك is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) made accusative by an omitted verb, i.e. "and we will save your family"; إلا: a particle of exception; امرأتك: the excepted; the clause ﴿كانت من الغابرين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); كانت: a defective past verb whose noun is latent (mustatir); and من الغابرين: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of ﴿كانت﴾.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿إنا منزلون على أهل هذه القرية رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يفسقون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and منزلون is its khabar (predicate); ﴿على أهل هذه القرية﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منزلون﴾; هذه: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); القرية is a genitive badal (substitute); رجزًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿منزلون﴾, because it is an active participle; ﴿من السماء﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رجزًا﴾; ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is causal and ما is maṣdariyya, i.e. "because of their transgressing", the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) being genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿منزلون﴾; كانوا is a defective past verb, the wāw of the plural being its noun; and the clause يفسقون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿ولقد تركنا منها آية بينة لقوم يعقلون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); تركنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركنا﴾, or it is its second object; آية is its first object; بينة is a naʿt (adjective); ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿بينة﴾; and the clause ﴿يعقلون﴾ is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿وإلى مدين أخاهم شعيبا فقال يا قوم اعبدوا الله وارجوا اليوم الآخر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إلى مدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, i.e. "and We sent to Madyan Shuʿayb"; ﴿أخاهم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); شعيبًا is a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the fāʾ is a conjunction; قال is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he"; يا is a vocative particle; قوم is a vocative (munādā) annexed to the omitted first-person yāʾ; ﴿اعبدوا الله﴾ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ارجوا﴾ is conjoined to اعبدوا; اليوم: mafʿūl bihi; and الآخر: a naʿt (adjective) of اليوم.
﴿ولا تعثوا في الأرض مفسدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تعثوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعثوا﴾; and مفسدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿فكذبوه فأخذتهم الرجفة فأصبحوا في دارهم جاثمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; كذبوه is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فأخذتهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أخذتهم is a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi; الرجفة is the postponed fāʿil; ﴿فأصبحوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿فأخذتهم﴾, and the wāw is the noun of أصبح; ﴿في دارهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاثمين﴾; and جاثمين is the khabar (predicate) of أصبحوا.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿وعادا وثمود وقد تبين لكم من مساكنهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; عادًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb conjoined to what precedes, i.e. "and We destroyed ʿĀd"; ثمود is conjoined to ﴿عادًا﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); تبين is a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); and ﴿من مساكنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبين﴾.
﴿وزين لهم الشيطان أعمالهم فصدهم عن السبيل وكانوا مستبصرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; زين is a past verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زين﴾; الشيطان is the fāʿil (agent); أعمالهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فصدهم﴾ is conjoined to زين; ﴿عن السبيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿صدهم﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); كانوا is a defective past verb, the wāw being its noun; and مستبصرين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وقارون وفرعون وهامان ولقد جاءهم موسى بالبينات فاستكبروا في الأرض وما كانوا سابقين﴾: ﴿وقارون وفرعون وهامان﴾ is conjoined to عاد; the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿جاءهم﴾ is a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); موسى is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿بالبينات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءهم﴾; ﴿فاستكبروا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿جاءهم﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿استكبروا﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating. ﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a defective past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and سابقين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿فكلا أخذنا بذنبه فمنهم من أرسلنا عليه حاصبا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted clause); كلًّا: a fronted object of ﴿أخذنا﴾; أخذنا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فمنهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and it is an indefinite noun qualified by a naʿt (nakira mawṣūfa); ﴿أرسلنا﴾ is its naʿt (adjective); عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; and ﴿حاصبًا﴾ is the object of أرسلنا.
﴿ومنهم من أخذته الصيحة ومنهم من خسفنا به الأرض ومنهم من أغرقنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿أخذته الصيحة﴾ is a naʿt (adjective); ﴿ومنهم من خسفنا به الأرض ومنهم من أغرقنا﴾: the two clauses are conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿وما كان الله ليظلمهم ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; ﴿كان الله﴾: كان is a defective past verb and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); ﴿يظلمهم﴾ is accusative (manṣūb) by أن necessarily concealed after the lām of denial; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of كان; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لكن﴾ is lightened and inoperative (mukhaffafa muhmala). ﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a defective past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, ﴿أنفسهم﴾ is a fronted object, and the clause ﴿يظلمون﴾ is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿مثل الذين اتخذوا من دون الله أولياء كمثل العنكبوت اتخذت بيتا وإن أوهن البيوت لبيت العنكبوت﴾: مثل is a mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿اتخذوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position, and it is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿من دون الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); أولياء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿كمثل﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); ﴿مَثل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿العنكبوت﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿اتخذت بيتًا﴾ is a ḥāl; ﴿وإن أوهن البيوت﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and إن its noun [Translator's note: so in the source; words appear to have dropped out — the intended sense is "إن is an abrogating particle and أوهن is its noun"]; ﴿البيوت﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿بيت﴾ is the khabar of إن; and العنكبوت: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿لو كانوا يعلمون﴾: لو is conditional; كان is a defective past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the apodosis (jawāb) of لو is omitted, its implied form being "they would not have worshipped them."

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿إن الله يعلم ما يدعون من دونه من شيء وهو العزيز الحكيم﴾: the clause is a statement of cause (taʿlīl) for what precedes it; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يعلم is its khabar (predicate); ما is a relative noun, the object of يعلم; the clause ﴿يدعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted; ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يدعون﴾. And it was said: ما is negating, and in ﴿من شيء﴾, ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and شيء is genitive in form, accusative in position as the object of يدعون, the clause ﴿ما يدعون﴾ being in the position of accusative as the object of يعلم. ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); العزيز is a first khabar; and الحكيم is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿وتلك الأمثال نضربها للناس وما يعقلها إلا العالمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تلك is a mubtadaʾ (subject); الأمثال is a badal (substitute); the clause ﴿نضربها للناس﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نضربها﴾; or الأمثال is the khabar, and the clause ﴿نضربها﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a second khabar; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; ﴿يعقلها﴾ is an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction; and العالمون is the fāʿil (agent) of يعقلها.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿خلق الله السماوات والأرض بالحق إن في ذلك لآية للمؤمنين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿خلق الله السماوات﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿والأرض﴾ is conjoined to السماوات; ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the bāʾ being for accompaniment (mulābasa); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is the postponed noun of إن; and ﴿للمؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿اتل ما أوحي إليك من الكتاب وأقم الصلاة﴾: اتل: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you", i.e. "O Muḥammad"; ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أوحي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; إليك: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحي﴾; ﴿من الكتاب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); أقم: an imperative verb conjoined to اتل, its fāʿil latent, its implied form likewise being "you"; and الصلاة: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر ولذكر الله أكبر والله يعلم ما تصنعون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), الصلاة is its noun, and the clause ﴿تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر﴾: its khabar (predicate); the wāw: resumptive; the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); ﴿ذكر الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the Name of Majesty: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿أكبر﴾: khabar; the clause ﴿ولذكر الله أكبر﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿والله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿يعلم﴾: a verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he", and the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar; ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿تصنعون﴾: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿ولا تجادلوا أهل الكتاب إلا بالتي هي أحسن إلا الذين ظلموا منهم﴾: «لا»: prohibitive; تجادلوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the wāw: fāʿil (agent); أهل: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الكتاب: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); إلا: a particle of restriction; بالتي: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تجادلوا﴾, the noun qualified by the relative being omitted, i.e. "with the disputation which"; ﴿هي﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); أحسن: khabar (predicate); and the clause: the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position. إلا: a particle of exception; الذين: the excepted; ظلموا: a verb and its fāʿil; and منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of ظلموا.
﴿وقولوا آمنا بالذي أنزل إلينا وأنزل إليكم وإلهنا وإلهكم واحد ونحن له مسلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قولوا: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); آمنا: a verb and its fāʿil, and it is the clause that is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); بالذي: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا; the clause أنزل: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إلينا: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل; أنزل إليكم: conjoined to أنزل إلينا, so there is an ellipsis of the relative noun in the speech, i.e. "and that which was sent down to you"; إلهنا: the wāw is a conjunction, and إلهنا is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلهكم: conjoined to إلهنا; واحد: khabar (predicate); نحن: mubtadaʾ; له: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مسلمون﴾; and مسلمون: the khabar of نحن.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿وكذلك أنزلنا إليك الكتاب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; كذلك: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "like that sending down We sent down"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; أنزلنا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); إليك: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلنا; الكتاب: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿وكذلك أنزلنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فالذين آتيناهم الكتاب يؤمنون به﴾: the fāʾ is for consequence (tafrīʿiyya); الذين: mubtadaʾ (subject); آتيناهم: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿آتيناهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; الكتاب: a second mafʿūl bihi; يؤمنون is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; and the clause يؤمنون به: the khabar (predicate) of الذين.
﴿ومن هؤلاء من يؤمن به﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من هؤلاء: fronted khabar (predicate); من: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause يؤمن به: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما يجحد بآياتنا إلا الكافرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما: negating; يجحد: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); بآياتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; إلا: a particle of restriction; and الكافرون: the fāʿil (agent) of يجحد.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وما كنت تتلو من قبله من كتاب ولا تخطه بيمينك إذا لارتاب المبطلون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما: negating; كنت: كان is a defective past verb and the tāʾ is its noun; تتلو is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you", and the clause ﴿تتلو﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان; من قبله: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتلو, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿كتاب﴾; من: a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; كتاب: genitive by من in form, accusative in position as the object of تتلو; the clause ﴿وما كنت...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the wāw: a conjunction; لا: negating; تخطه: an imperfect verb conjoined to تتلو; بيمينك: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تخطه﴾; إذًا: a particle of response and requital, inoperative; لارتاب: the lām occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "had any of that been so, the falsifiers would have doubted"; ارتاب: a past verb; and المبطلون: fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿بل هو آيات بينات في صدور الذين أوتوا العلم﴾: بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); هو: mubtadaʾ (subject); آيات: khabar (predicate); بينات: a naʿt (adjective) of آيات; في صدور: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second khabar of هو; الذين: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause أوتوا العلم: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and العلم: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أوتوا.
﴿وما يجحد بآياتنا إلا الظالمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما: negating; يجحد: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); بآياتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; إلا: a particle of restriction; and الظالمون: the fāʿil (agent) of يجحد.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وقالوا لولا أنزل عليه آيات من ربه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; قالوا: a past verb, and the wāw: fāʿil (agent); لولا: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), equivalent to هلّا; أنزل: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); عليه: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل; آيات: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); من ربه: a preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of آيات, or attached to أنزل; and the clause ﴿وقالوا لولا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قل إنما الآيات عند الله وإنما أنا نذير مبين﴾: قل: an imperative verb; إنما: the restraining ما with the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); الآيات: mubtadaʾ (subject); عند الله: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted which is the khabar (predicate); ﴿وإنما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and إنما: kāffa wa-makfūfa; أنا: mubtadaʾ; نذير: khabar; and مبين: naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿أولم يكفهم أنا أنزلنا عليك الكتاب يتلى عليهم﴾: the hamza is interrogative; the wāw: conjoining to something omitted and implied, which the context requires; لم: a particle of negation, inversion (qalb) and jussive; يكفهم: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; the hāʾ: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the plural marker; أنّ and what follows it: the fāʿil (agent) of يكفهم; أنا: أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) and ﴿نا﴾ its noun; the clause أنزلنا عليك الكتاب: the khabar (predicate) of أن; and the clause يتلى عليهم: a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن في ذلك لرحمة وذكرى لقوم يؤمنون﴾: إن is a particle of emphasis and accusative; في ذلك: its fronted khabar (predicate); the lām: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); رحمة: its postponed noun; ذكرى: conjoined to رحمة; لقوم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of ذكرى; and the clause يؤمنون: a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿قل كفى بالله بيني وبينكم شهيدا يعلم ما في السماوات والأرض﴾: قل: an imperative verb; كفى: a past verb; the bāʾ: a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ in form, the fāʿil (agent) of كفى, nominative in position; بيني: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شهيدًا﴾; بينكم: conjoined to ﴿بيني﴾; شهيدًا: tamyīz (specification); the clause ﴿يعلم﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ما: the object of يعلم; في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and الأرض: conjoined to السماوات.
﴿والذين آمنوا بالباطل وكفروا بالله أولئك هم الخاسرون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الذين: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آمنوا: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; بالباطل: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنوا; كفروا بالله: conjoined to آمنوا بالباطل; أولئك: mubtadaʾ; هم: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; and الخاسرون: the khabar (predicate) of أولئك; or ﴿هم﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ, الخاسرون the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿هم الخاسرون﴾ the khabar of أولئك. The clause ﴿أولئك هم الخاسرون﴾ is the khabar of الذين, and the clause ﴿والذين آمنوا بالباطل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ويستعجلونك بالعذاب ولولا أجل مسمى لجاءهم العذاب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يستعجلونك: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw: fāʿil (agent), and the kāf: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالعذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يستعجلونك; the clause ﴿ويستعجلونك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the wāw is resumptive; لولا: a particle of non-occurrence due to existence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); أجل: mubtadaʾ (subject); مسمى: naʿt (adjective); the khabar (predicate) is omitted; the lām: linking the apodosis; جاءهم العذاب: a verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the clause ﴿ولولا أجل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وليأتينهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām: occurring in the response to an implied oath; يأتينهم: an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because of its attachment to the heavy nūn of emphasis, the fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it"; هم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بغتة: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿لا يشعرون﴾: khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿وهم لا يشعرون﴾: a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿يستعجلونك بالعذاب﴾: يستعجلونك: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw: fāʿil (agent), and the kāf: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالعذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يستعجلونك. The clause ﴿يستعجلونك بالعذاب﴾ is repeated to express wonder at their foolishness, for whoever is threatened with something seeks the means of guarding against it, whereas these people hasten it on.
﴿وإن جهنم لمحيطة بالكافرين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and جهنم is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); محيطة: the khabar (predicate) of إن; and بالكافرين: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) محيطة.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿يوم يغشاهم العذاب من فوقهم ومن تحت أرجلهم﴾: يوم: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) محيطة; ﴿يغشاهم العذاب﴾ is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿يغشاهم العذاب﴾ is in the position of genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; من فوقهم: a ḥāl (circumstantial); and من تحت أرجلهم: conjoined to من فوقهم.
﴿ويقول ذوقوا ما كنتم تعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يقول: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he", and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿يغشاهم..﴾; the clause ذوقوا: the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and it is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause كنتم: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause تعملون: the khabar (predicate) of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿يا عبادي الذين آمنوا إن أرضي واسعة فإياي فاعبدون﴾: يا: a vocative particle; عبادي: a vocative (munādā) annexed to the first-person yāʾ; الذين: a naʿt (adjective) of عبادي; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ﴿أرضي﴾ is the noun of إن, and ﴿واسعة﴾ the khabar (predicate) of إن. ﴿فإياي﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, and إياي is a detached pronoun in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb explained by the mentioned verb, its implied form being "worship"; the clause ﴿إياي اعبدوا﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the implied condition; and the meaning is: "If a place becomes narrow for you, then Me worship, for My earth is wide and will not become narrow for you." ﴿فاعبدونِ﴾: the fāʾ is connective (ṣila), for embellishment; اعبدونِ: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw of the plural being the fāʿil (agent), the nūn for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the omitted first-person yāʾ the object; and the clause ﴿اعبدونِ﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿كل نفس ذائقة الموت ثم إلينا ترجعون﴾: كل نفس: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ذائقة: khabar (predicate); and الموت: muḍāf ilayhi. ثم: a conjunction; إلينا: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترجعون﴾; ترجعون: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); and the wāw: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لنبوئنهم من الجنة غرفا﴾: the wāw: resumptive; الذين: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آمنوا: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the wāw: a conjunction; the clause عملوا الصالحات: conjoined to the clause آمنوا; the lām: occurring in the response to an implied oath; نبوئنهم: an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because of its attachment to the heavy nūn of emphasis, the fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we", and هم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the oath clause: the khabar (predicate) of الذين; من الجنة: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿غرفا﴾; and غرفًا: a second mafʿūl bihi. You may also make ﴿الذين﴾ accusative by an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned after it, namely ﴿لنبوئنهم﴾; and the clause ﴿والذين آمنوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها نعم أجر العاملين﴾: تجري: an imperfect verb; من تحتها: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجري; الأنهار: fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of غرفًا; خالدين: a ḥāl (circumstantial); فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خالدين; نعم: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb; أجر: the fāʿil of نعم; العاملين: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bil-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. "Paradise".

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿الذين صبروا وعلى ربهم يتوكلون﴾: الذين: a naʿt (adjective) of العاملين; the clause صبروا: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; على ربهم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتوكلون﴾; يتوكلون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; and the wāw: its fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وكأين من دابة لا تحمل رزقها﴾: the wāw is resumptive; كأين: in the sense of the informative كم (kam al-khabariyya), and it is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); من دابة: a preposition and its genitive noun, and دابة is the tamyīz (specification) of كأين; and the clause لا تحمل رزقها: a naʿt (adjective) of دابة.
And His saying ﴿الله يرزقها وإياكم﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يرزقها: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿الله يرزقها﴾ is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ ﴿كأين﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; إياكم: a detached accusative pronoun conjoined to the hāʾ; and the clause ﴿وكأين من دابة...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهو السميع العليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; هو: mubtadaʾ (subject); السميع: first khabar (predicate); العليم: second khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿ولئن سألتهم من خلق السماوات والأرض وسخر الشمس والقمر ليقولن الله فأنى يؤفكون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; سألتهم is a past verb, the tāʾ the fāʿil (agent), and هم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿سألتهم﴾ is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); من: an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾: the khabar (predicate) of مَن, and the [whole] clause is in the position of accusative as the second object of سألتهم; ﴿سخر الشمس والقمر﴾: conjoined to ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾; the lām occurs in the response to the oath; يقولن: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which is dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters: fāʿil; the doubled nūn: the heavy nūn of emphasis; الله: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He"; the clause ﴿ولئن سألتهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted clause); أنى: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); يؤفكون: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); and the wāw: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر له إن الله بكل شيء عليم﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يبسط الرزق﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); لمن: the lām is a preposition, ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبسط﴾; the clause يشاء: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; من عباده: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted returning pronoun (ʿāʾid); يقدر: an imperfect verb conjoined to يبسط; له: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقدر; إن الله: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) and the Name of Majesty its noun; بكل: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عليم; شيء: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and عليم: the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿ولئن سألتهم من نزل من السماء ماء فأحيا به الأرض من بعد موتها ليقولن الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; سألتهم is a past verb, the tāʾ the fāʿil (agent), and هم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿سألتهم﴾ is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); مَن: an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); نزل: a past verb; من السماء: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نزل﴾; ماء: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿نزل من السماء ماء﴾: the khabar (predicate) of مَن; the clause ﴿من نزَّل ...﴾ is in the position of accusative as the second object of سألتهم; the clause ﴿فأحيا به الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿نزل من السماء ماء﴾; ﴿من بعد موتها﴾ is a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أحيا﴾; the lām occurs in the response to the oath; يقولن: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which is dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil; the doubled nūn: the heavy nūn of emphasis; and the Name of Majesty is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He". The clause ﴿ولئن سألتهم﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause ﴿ولئن سألتهم﴾.
﴿قل الحمد لله بل أكثرهم لا يعقلون﴾: قل: an imperative verb; الحمد: mubtadaʾ (subject); لله: khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); بل: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); أكثرهم: mubtadaʾ; and the clause لا يعقلون: khabar.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿وما هذه الحياة الدنيا إلا لهو ولعب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negating; هذه: mubtadaʾ (subject); الحياة: badal (substitute); الدنيا: a naʿt (adjective) of الحياة; إلا: a particle of restriction; لهو: the khabar (predicate) of هذه; لعب: conjoined to لهو; and the clause ﴿وما هذه الحياة...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن الدار الآخرة لهي الحيوان لو كانوا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and الدار its noun; الآخرة: a naʿt (adjective) of الدار; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); هي: mubtadaʾ (subject); الحيوان: khabar (predicate), and the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن; لو: conditional; كانوا: كان is a defective past verb, the wāw of the plural its noun, and the clause يعلمون the khabar of كان; and the apodosis (jawāb) of لو is omitted, its implied form being "they would not have preferred the life of this world."

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿فإذا ركبوا في الفلك دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إذا: an adverb (ẓarf) of the future containing the sense of condition; ركبوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿ركبوا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; في الفلك: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ركبوا; the clause ﴿دعوا الله﴾: has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; مخلصين: a ḥāl (circumstantial); له: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مخلصين; الدين: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of مخلصين, because ﴿مخلصين﴾ is an active participle; and the clause ﴿فإذا ركبوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلما نجاهم إلى البر إذا هم يشركون﴾: the fāʾ: a conjunction; لما: an adverb (ẓarf) meaning "when", containing the sense of condition; نجاهم: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلى البر: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) نجاهم; إذا: of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and together with what it governs it is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the response of لما; هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause يشركون: the khabar (predicate) of «هم».

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿ليكفروا بما آتيناهم وليتمتعوا فسوف يعلمون﴾: the lām: the lām of causation (taʿlīl) or the lām of consequence (ʿāqiba); يكفروا: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن concealed after the lām, the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb being genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يشركون﴾; or the lām is the lām of command, and the imperfect after it is jussive (majzūm); the wāw of the plural: fāʿil (agent); بما: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يكفروا﴾; the clause ﴿آتيناهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ليتمتعوا: conjoined to ليكفروا, so it is like it; the fāʾ: the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted clause); سوف: a particle of futurity; and يعلمون: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿أولم يروا أنا جعلنا حرما آمنا ويتخطف الناس من حولهم﴾: the hamza: for disapproving, affirmative interrogation (istifhām inkārī taqrīrī); the wāw: conjoining to something omitted, i.e. "We have made them secure, settled in Makka, and have they not known that?"; لم: a particle of negation, inversion (qalb) and jussive; يروا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the wāw: fāʿil (agent); أنا: أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ its noun, and the clause جعلنا its khabar (predicate); the first object of جعلنا is omitted, i.e. "We made their town Makka"; حرمًا: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن and what follows it: fills the place of the two objects of يروا; آمنًا: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حرما﴾; the wāw: circumstantial (ḥāliyya); يتخطف: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); الناس: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and من حولهم: a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أفبالباطل يؤمنون وبنعمة الله يكفرون﴾: the hamza: for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); the fāʾ: conjoining to something omitted; بالباطل: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; and ﴿بنعمة الله يكفرون﴾: conjoined to what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿ومن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو كذب بالحق لما جاءه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من: an interrogative noun containing the sense of negation, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); أظلم: khabar (predicate); ممن: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم; the clause ﴿افترى على الله﴾: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿كذبا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb افترى, i.e. "he fabricated and contrived a lie", or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "he fabricated for the sake of lying", or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "he fabricated while lying", and it is an emphasising ḥāl. The clause ﴿ومن أظلم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أو: a conjunction; كذب: conjoined to افترى; بالحق: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذب; لما: temporal ("when"); and جاءه: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أليس في جهنم مثوى للكافرين﴾: the hamza is for affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī); ليس: a defective past verb; في جهنم: the fronted khabar (predicate) of ليس; مثوى: its postponed noun; and للكافرين: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of مثوى.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿والذين جاهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا وإن الله لمع المحسنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿جاهدوا﴾: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the object of جاهدوا is omitted; فينا: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهدوا; the lām: occurring in the response to an implied oath; the clause ﴿لنهدينهم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of الذين; سبلنا: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or accusative by removal of the preposition; the clause ﴿والذين جاهدوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن الله: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) and the Name of Majesty its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and مع المحسنين: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿الم﴾: the discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿أحسب الناس أن يتركوا أن يقولوا آمنا وهم لا يفتنون﴾: ﴿أحسب﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and (حسب) is a past verb; ﴿الناس﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); أن and what lies within its scope stand in place of the two objects of حسب; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن يقولوا﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by an implied (muqaddar) lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتركوا﴾; the clause ﴿آمنا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿لا يفتنون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; the clause is circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿ولقد فتنا الذين من قبلهم فليعلمن الله الذين صدقوا وليعلمن الكاذبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is in answer to an implied oath; (قد) is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿فتنا﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿الذين﴾ is its object; ﴿من قبلهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element that is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The fāʾ is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; ﴿يعلمن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the Majestic Name is the fāʿil; ﴿الذين﴾ is its object, and the clause ﴿صدقوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿وليعلمن الكاذبين﴾ is conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿أم حسب الذين يعملون السيئات أن يسبقونا﴾: (أم): disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), meaning "بل" (rather) plus the interrogative hamza, the implied form being "بل أحسب ..."; the interrogation is for disapproval (inkār); ﴿حسب﴾ is a past verb; ﴿الذين﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يعملون السيئات﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. أن and what lies within its scope stand in place of the two objects of حسب.
﴿ساء ما يحكمون﴾: the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿ساء﴾ is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil is necessarily latent (mustatir), its implied form being ﴿هو﴾. ﴿ما﴾: a described indefinite (nakira mawṣūfa) in the position of accusative as a tamyīz (specification) of the fāʿil of ﴿ساء﴾, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted. The clause ﴿يحكمون﴾ is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾, the implied form being "ساء حكمًا يحكمونه" (evil is a judgement that they make).
Or ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun meaning "الذي" (that which), in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of ﴿ساء﴾, and the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "حكمهم" (their judgement). The clause ﴿يحكمون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya. The clause ﴿يحكمون﴾ is the ṣila of maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. The interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿ما﴾ and what it entered upon is the one specified for blame, the implied form being "ساء حكمًا حكمهم" (evil as a judgement is their judgement).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿من كان يرجو لقاء الله فإن أجل الله لآت وهو السميع العليم﴾: ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the noun of كان is latent (mustatir), referring to من; the clause ﴿يرجو﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان; ﴿لقاء﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿إن أجل﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (أجل) its noun, the Majestic Name muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ﴿آت﴾ is the khabar of إن; the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿السميع العليم﴾ are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾; the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of nominative as the khabar of من.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿ومن جاهد فإنما يجاهد لنفسه إن الله لغني عن العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾ is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿جاهد﴾ is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); ﴿إنما﴾: a restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿يجاهد﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; ﴿لنفسه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يجاهد﴾; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Majestic Name its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ﴿غني﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿عن العالمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿غني﴾; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لنكفرن عنهم سيئاتهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (الذين): mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿وعملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to آمنوا; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; (نكفرن): an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿الذين﴾; ﴿عنهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نكفرن﴾; (سيئاتهم): mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولنجزينهم أحسن الذي كانوا يعملون﴾: ﴿ولنجزينهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لنكفرن﴾; ﴿أحسن﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿الذي﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (كانوا) is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ووصينا الإنسان بوالديه حسنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ﴿وصينا﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); (الإنسان): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بوالديه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وصينا﴾; ﴿حسنا﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun) on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "إيصاء ذا حسن" (an enjoining possessing goodness); the clause ﴿ووصينا الإنسان...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن جاهداك لتشرك بي ما ليس لك به علم فلا تطعهما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (جاهداك): a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the alif is the fāʿil, and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi; (لتشرك): the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and (تشرك) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جاهداك﴾; ﴿بي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تشرك﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تشرك﴾; (ليس): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿لك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ليس﴾, placed first; ﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿عِلْم﴾; ﴿عِلْم﴾ is the postponed noun of ليس; the clause ﴿ليس لك به علم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ), because the apodosis is a clause; (لا) is prohibitive; ﴿تطعهما﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, its fāʿil latent, and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, while the mīm and the alif are two letters indicating the dual; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of إن.
﴿إلي مرجعكم فأنبئكم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: ﴿إليَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; ﴿مرجعكم﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أنبئكم﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "أنا", and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنبئكم﴾; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the khabar of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لندخلنهم في الصالحين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (الذين): mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿وعملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to آمنوا; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; (ندخلن): an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في الصالحين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ندخلنهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿ومن الناس من يقول آمنا بالله﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ﴿من الناس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مَن﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يقول ...﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿آمنا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿بالله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آمنا﴾; the clause ﴿ومن الناس...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فإذا أوذي في الله جعل فتنة الناس كعذاب الله﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إذا): an adverb (ẓarf) of the future containing the sense of condition; ﴿في الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أوذي﴾; the clause ﴿أوذي﴾ is in the position of genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the clause ﴿جعل﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of إذا; ﴿فتنة﴾ is the first object of جعل, and (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿كعذاب﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the second object; ﴿عذاب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the Majestic Name is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ولئن جاء نصر من ربك ليقولن إنا كنا معكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) is a jussive-governing conditional particle; ﴿جاء﴾ is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (نصر): fāʿil (agent); ﴿من ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جاء﴾, or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نصر﴾. ﴿ليقولن﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; (يقولن): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters, and the wāw of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿إنا كنا معكم﴾ is the object of the saying; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ its noun, and the clause ﴿كنا﴾ its khabar; ﴿معكم﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿كان﴾.
﴿أوليس الله بأعلم بما في صدور العالمين﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw conjoins to something omitted that the context requires; ﴿ليس﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the Majestic Name its noun; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) particle; (أعلم): genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position as the khabar of ليس; ﴿بما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; ﴿في صدور العالمين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. (العالمين): muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿وليعلمن الله الذين آمنوا وليعلمن المنافقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; ﴿يعلمن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the Majestic Name is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿الذين﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿وليعلمن المنافقين﴾ is conjoined to ﴿وليعلمن الله الذين آمنوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وقال الذين كفروا للذين آمنوا اتبعوا سبيلنا ولنحمل خطاياكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ﴿قال الذين﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿للذين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿اتبعوا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (اتبعوا): verb and fāʿil; ﴿سبيلنا﴾: object; the clause ﴿وقال الذين كفروا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿لنحمل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of command (lām al-amr), and (نحمل) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; (خطاياكم): mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وما هم بحاملين من خطاياهم من شيء إنهم لكاذبون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like ليس; ﴿هم﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿بحاملين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿حاملين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative (manṣūb) in position, genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ; ﴿من خطاياهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of شيء and was placed before it; (من) is a connective particle, and (شيء) is genitive in form, accusative in position, because it is the object of حاملين; the clause ﴿إنهم لكاذبون﴾ is causal (taʿlīl); (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿هم﴾ its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ﴿كاذبون﴾ its khabar.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وليحملن أثقالهم وأثقالا مع أثقالهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; ﴿يحملن﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters, and the wāw of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿أثقالهم﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأثقالًا﴾ is conjoined to أثقالهم; ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أثقالًا﴾; ﴿أثقالهم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وليسألن يوم القيامة عما كانوا يفترون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿يسألن﴾ is conjoined to يحملن; ﴿يوم القيامة﴾: an adverb attached to ﴿يسألن﴾, and (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿عما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun likewise attached to ﴿يسألن﴾; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause ﴿يفترون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ولقد أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه فلبث فيهم ألف سنة إلا خمسين عاما﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the lām is in answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿أرسلنا﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿نوحًا﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿إلى قومه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾. The clause ﴿ولقد أرسلنا نوحا﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿فلبث﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (لبث) a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); ﴿فيهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿لبث﴾; ﴿ألف سنة﴾ is accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), and it is likewise attached to ﴿لبث﴾; (إلا): a particle of exception (istithnāʾ); ﴿خمسين﴾ is accusative as the excepted (mustathnā); ﴿عامًا﴾ is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿فأخذهم الطوفان وهم ظالمون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أخذهم الطوفان﴾: a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and a postponed fāʿil; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (ظالمون) the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿فأنجيناه وأصحاب السفينة وجعلناها آية للعالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أنجيناه﴾: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وأصحاب﴾ is conjoined to the hāʾ, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); (السفينة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وجعلناها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿جعلناها﴾ is verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; ﴿آية﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿للعالمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وإبراهيم إذ قال لقومه﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (إبراهيم) is accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of ﴿إبراهيم﴾; ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the clause (قال لقومه) is in the position of genitive by annexation; ﴿لقومه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾.
﴿اعبدوا الله واتقوه ذلكم خير لكم إن كنتم تعلمون﴾: the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of Abraham to his people; ﴿اعبدوا﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the Majestic Name is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿واتقوه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿اذكروا الله﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in this ayah is ﴿اعبدوا الله﴾]; ﴿ذلكم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿خير﴾ khabar (predicate), and ﴿لكم﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خير﴾; (إن) is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿تعلمون﴾ its khabar; the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "فاعبدوا الله واتقوه" (then worship Allah and fear Him).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿إنما تعبدون من دون الله أوثانا وتخلقون إفكا﴾: (إنما): a restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿تعبدون﴾: an imperfect verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿من دون الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the Majestic Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿أوثانًا﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وتخلقون إفكًا﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿إن الذين تعبدون من دون الله لا يملكون لكم رزقا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (الذين) its noun, and the clause (تعبدون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿من دون الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause ﴿لا يملكون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿رزقًا﴾; (رزقًا): the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يملكون﴾, because it has the meaning of "that which is provided" (al-marzūq).
﴿فابتغوا عند الله الرزق واعبدوه واشكروا له إليه ترجعون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause); (ابتغوا): imperative verb and fāʿil; ﴿عند الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ابتغوا﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, "جار ومجرور", though عند is an adverb (ẓarf)]; ﴿الرزق﴾ is the object of ابتغوا; ﴿واعبدوه واشكروا له﴾ is conjoined to ابتغوا; ﴿إليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ترجعون﴾; (ترجعون): an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وإن تكذبوا فقد كذب أمم من قبلكم﴾: conjoined to what preceded; (إن) is conditional; (تكذبوا): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿فقد﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb), because it is joined with قد, and (قد) is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿كذب أمم﴾: verb and fāʿil; ﴿من قبلكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمم; and it has been said: the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "فلا يضرني تكذيبكم، فقد كذب أمم من قبلكم أنبياءهم ورسلهم" (your denial does not harm me, for nations before you denied their prophets and messengers).
﴿وما على الرسول إلا البلاغ المبين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (ما) is negating; ﴿على الرسول﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿البلاغ﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿المبين﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿بلاغ﴾; the clause ﴿وما على الرسول...﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿أولم يروا كيف يبدئ الله الخلق ثم يعيده إن ذلك على الله يسير﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw conjoins to something omitted that the context requires; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past); ﴿كيف﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿يبدئ الله الخلق﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of يروا; ﴿ثم يعيده﴾ is resumptive speech with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (ذلك) its noun; ﴿على الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسير﴾; (يسير): the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿قل سيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف بدأ الخلق﴾: (سيروا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سيروا﴾; ﴿فانظروا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿سيروا﴾; ﴿كيف﴾ is an indeclinable interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿بدأ الخلق﴾: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of انظروا, which is suspended (muʿallaq) because of the interrogative.
﴿ثم الله ينشئ النشأة الآخرة إن الله على كل شيء قدير﴾: (ثم): a conjunction; (الله): mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (ينشئ): khabar (predicate); ﴿النشأة الآخرة﴾ is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun, i.e. absolute object); (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Majestic Name its noun; ﴿على كل شيء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قدير﴾; (قدير): the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿يعذب من يشاء ويرحم من يشاء وإليه تقلبون﴾: the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or a second khabar (predicate) of إن, or resumptive, with no grammatical position; (يعذب): an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", referring to Allah; (من): a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause (يشاء) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿ويرحم من يشاء﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يعذب من يشاء﴾; (إليه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقلبون﴾; ﴿تقلبون﴾ is an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وما أنتم بمعجزين في الأرض ولا في السماء وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like ليس; ﴿أنتم﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿بمعجزين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿معجزين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative (manṣūb) in position, genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ; ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the object of معجزين is omitted since it is known, i.e. Allah the Exalted; ﴿ولا في السماء﴾ is conjoined to ﴿في الأرض﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; ﴿من دون الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the Majestic Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿من ولي﴾: (من) is a connective particle, and (ولي) is genitive in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿ولا نصير﴾ is conjoined to من ولي.

zajjaj:38-38.t: His saying: ﴿وَعادًا وثَمُودَ وقَدْ تَبَيَّنَ لَكم مِن مَساكِنِهِمْ﴾ — the meaning is: "And We destroyed ʿĀd and Thamūd", because before this come Qārūn and his companions, ﴿فَأخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ﴾ (so the earthquake seized them). [Translator's note: the source says Qārūn and his companions come before this; in the muṣḥaf the preceding verses (36–37) concern Madyan and Shuʿayb, and Qārūn is mentioned in verse 39 after it. Translated as written.]

zajjaj:40-40.t: His saying: ﴿فَكُلا أخَذْنا بِذَنْبِهِ فَمِنهم مَن أرْسَلْنا عَلَيْهِ حاصِبًا﴾ — these are the people of Lūṭ; ﴿وَمِنهم مَن أخَذَتْهُ الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ — these are the people of Thamūd, and Madyan; ﴿وَمِنهم مَن خَسَفْنا بِهِ الأرْضَ﴾ — these are Qārūn and his companions; ﴿وَمِنهم مَن أغْرَقْنا﴾ — these are the people of Nūḥ, and Pharaoh. So Allah made known that what was done to them was justice, that He did not wrong them, and that they wronged themselves, because He had made things clear to them; and that is His saying: ﴿وَكانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ﴾ [al-ʿAnkabūt: 38] — they did what they did although He had made clear to them that its outcome would be their punishment.

zajjaj:41-41.t: His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أوْلِياءَ كَمَثَلِ العَنْكَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا﴾ — the verse. ”لَوْ“ is connected to His saying ”اِتَّخَذُوا“, i.e. "if they knew that their taking of protectors is like the spider's taking [of a house]"; it is not that they do not know that the spider's house is weak. That is because there is no house weaker than the spider's house among what vermin make for themselves as dwellings, nor any that gives less protection from heat or cold. The meaning is that their protectors do not diminish them [Translator's note: so in the source, «لا يَنْقُصُونَهُمْ»; probably a copyist's error for «لا يَنْفَعُونَهُمْ», "do not benefit them"], do not provide for them, and do not ward off any harm from them, just as the spider's house does not protect the spider.

zajjaj:45-45.t:
His saying, Exalted is He: ﴿وَأقِمِ الصَّلاةَ إنَّ الصَّلاةَ تَنْهى عَنِ الفَحْشاءِ والمُنْكَرِ﴾ — al-Ḥasan and Qatāda said: "Whoever is not restrained by his prayer from indecency and wrongdoing, his prayer is no prayer, and it is a burden of ruin upon him."
His saying: ﴿وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أكْبَرُ﴾ — there are several aspects (awjuh) in it. Among them: that ”أكْبَرُ“ is in the meaning of ”كَبِيرٌ“ (great).
